reference_estimation.description: Median LOS displacement of valid high-coherence reference candidate pixels.

displacement.interpretation: Relative LOS displacement with respect to the selected reference estimate.

coherence.interpretation: Higher correlation indicates stronger interferometric consistency; low correlation indicates reduced reliability.

notes: The reference estimate is relative and does not represent absolute ground motion.
A high-coherence candidate does not automatically prove physical stability.
Reference selection must be scientifically reviewed before final project freeze.
Low coherence must not be interpreted as zero displacement.
The current Shyamsundarpur AOI is temporary and must be replaced by an authoritative boundary before final scientific results.
